name: TFRBench
description: TFRBench evaluates temporal forecasting reasoning in LLMs, going beyond accuracy-at-a-point to assess whether models can justify predictions with coherent causal and temporal reasoning chains. It distinguishes models that guess correct answers from those that understand why outcomes occur.
reputation: Very recent; introduced in 2026 as a reasoning-focused complement to accuracy-only forecasting benchmarks.
notes: Explicitly separates forecasting reasoning quality from prediction accuracy, addressing a gap where models can achieve correct outputs via spurious correlations rather than causal understanding.
